units.source_text: ……这么一想，单凭金阁宽恕这一点，音乐的部力也就淡薄了。

en.t: ... Thinking of it this way, the mere fact that the Golden Pavilion forgave me was enough to make the power of music fade.

units.source_text: 因为既然金阁默认了，音乐再怎么类似生，也只不过是国品的架空的生，

en.t: Because, once the Golden Pavilion had tacitly accepted it, no matter how much music resembled life, it was still only the imaginary life of a work of art,

units.source_text: 纵令我想化身为生，这种化身也只能是短暂的。

en.t: and even if I wanted to transform myself into life itself, that transformation could only be momentary.
